verdict.rationale: Nitrokey ships an official CLI and Python SDK, so publishing a machine-readable interface spec is a fair question for this product. However, probes of every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path on its docs site returned 404, and no evidence shows any downloadable API spec or equivalent. The CLI and SDK are adjacent tooling, not a spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
